items.teaser: Tech-Milliardär Musk wirft der Ukraine vor, seinen Satelliten-Internetdienst Starlink für tödliche Drohnenangriffe missbraucht zu haben. Das System sei kein "Mittel zum Töten", sagte Musk. Die Sicherheitslücke sei inzwischen aber geschlossen.

items.title: Russian drone strikes five-story apartment building in Vinnytsia, six injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a five-story residential building in Vinnytsia with a drone, injuring six people.

items.title: Bulgaria holds presidential elections amid divisions over Ukraine war

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,578,450 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022

items.title: Verluste russischer Armee in Ukraine liegen binnen eines Tages bei 1850 weiteren Angreifern
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 25. Oktober 2024 bei rund 1.578.450 Soldaten. Binnen eines Tages wurden weitere 1850 Besatzer getötet.

items.title: "Putin setzt auf Zeit" - und die Wahlen in Europa 2027
items.teaser: Vor möglichen Ukraine-Gesprächen im November bremst Politikwissenschaftler Gerhard Mangott die Erwartungen an Fortschritte. Putin stehe nicht unter Druck, aufzuhören.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 119 von 153 russischen Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 119 von 153 Kampfdrohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Abend dem 24. Oktober das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: Russian drone strikes apartment building in Vinnytsia: six injured, four flats destroyed – photos
items.teaser: A Russian drone hit a five-storey apartment building in Vinnytsia, injuring six people and destroying four flats.

items.title: Air defense neutralizes 119 of 153 drones Russia launched at Ukraine overnight
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 119 of the 153 drones launched by Russian invaders at Ukraine since the evening of October 24.

items.title: Russia attacks Ukraine with 153 drones: hits recorded at 15 locations
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defence shot down or jammed 119 out of 153 Russian drones overnight, with hits recorded at 15 locations, the Air Force says.

items.title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 1,850 over past day
items.teaser: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to October 25, 2026, have reached approximately 1,578,450 personnel, including 1,850 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Anpassung der Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für Ausfuhren nach Russland
items.teaser: Die Muster zu Endverbleibserklärungen für unmittelbare und mittelbare Ausfuhren nach Russland (Anlagen C 6 und C 7) wurden aktualisiert und sind ab sofort auf der BAFA-Internetseite abrufbar.

items.title: Russian invaders attack Mykolaiv region with drones over past day, causing damage
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked the Mykolaiv region with Shahed-type UAVs and FPV drones over the past day, causing damage.

items.title: Russia loses 1,850 soldiers and 49 artillery systems over past day

items.teaser: SpaceX owner Elon Musk has said that using the civilian Starlink system to carry out drone attacks "to kill people has never been allowed."

items.title: Drones attack Russia's Belgorod, sparking major fire
items.teaser: Drones attacked central Belgorod overnight, sparking a large fire and damaging buildings and cars; a shopping centre may have been hit.

items.title: About 63% of Germans support maintaining or increasing military aid to Ukraine
items.teaser: In Germany, 63% of citizens support maintaining or increasing the current level of military support for Ukraine from European countries, while 32% favor reducing it.

items.title: Russian attack on commercial premises in Zaporizhzhia sparks fire
items.teaser: Russian forces have struck commercial premises in Zaporizhzhia, causing a fire.

items.title: Russia turning temporarily occupied territories into criminal enclaves – Ukraine's intelligence
items.teaser: Russian invaders are turning temporarily occupied Ukrainian territories into criminal enclaves.

items.title: Almost 283,000 Russian soldiers killed in Ukraine identified by media investigation
items.teaser: Since Mediazona last updated the figures in early October, the names of 6,880 Russian soldiers were added to the list of those killed.

items.title: Ukraine switches to standard time tonight
items.teaser: On the night of Saturday, October 24, through Sunday, October 25, Ukrainians will switch to standard time by setting their clocks back one hour at 4:00 a.m.

items.title: Military paramedic and veteran Olena Sharhovska dies at 43
items.teaser: Military paramedic and veteran Olena "Jane" Sharhovska, who worked as a journalist and editor in civilian life, has died at the age of 43.

items.title: Sanctioned Russian energy giant secretly funded US gas project, NYT reports
items.teaser: The gas project was part of an energy deal discussed by U.S. peace envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner during their September visit to the Kremlin, sources told the New York Times.

items.title: Rückkehr nach Sieg über Hamas: Israel vertreibt 2000 Palästinenser aus Hebron
items.teaser: Kurz vor der Parlamentswahl in Israel geht die Armee massiv gegen die Stadt Hebron im Westjordanland vor. Nach einem Terroranschlag müssen 2000 Palästinenser ihre Häuser verlassen. Verteidigungsminister Katz stellt eine Rückkehr erst nach einem Ende des Kampfes gegen die Hamas in Aussicht.

items.title: Trump says US will do business with both Ukraine and Russia after war
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump has said the US plans to do business with both Ukraine and Russia once the war ends.

items.title: Speleologist and traveler Borys Hora killed in action
items.teaser: Borys Hora, a well-known speleologist, guide, traveler and public figure from Ternopil, has been killed in the war.

items.title: Massive Ukrainian drone attack hits shopping center in Russia's Belgorod Oblast, locals say
items.teaser: MegaGRINN is the largest shopping complex in Belgorod, covering over 163,000 square meters and housing more than 200 shops. The center was closed and empty of visitors during the reported overnight attack.

items.title: 55th Molodist Film Festival opens in Kyiv with over 100 films from 50 countries
items.teaser: The opening ceremony of the 55th Kyiv International Film Festival “Molodist” will take place in Kyiv on Saturday, October 24.

items.title: One killed and four injured in Russian drone strike on Kharkiv
items.teaser: A Russian jet-powered drone struck Kharkiv's Novobavarskyi district, killing one person and injuring four, Mayor Ihor Terekhov says.

items.title: Deadly Russian drone strike targets apartment in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, killing 3, injuring 12
items.teaser: One of the injured victims is an 11-year-old girl. Five wounded individuals are being treated in the hospital, with two in serious condition and undergoing surgery.

items.title: SBU detains Donetsk woman who fought for Russia and planned to leave for EU
items.teaser: The Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) counterintelligence officers have detained a resident of temporarily occupied Donetsk in the Volyn region who, according to investigators, fought on Russia's side.

items.title: Durchsuchung nach Schüssen: "Mein Kampf", Koran und Bibel bei Pariser Attentäter gefunden
items.teaser: Bereits kurz nach der Tat ordnet Frankreichs Präsident Macron die tödlichen Schüsse in Paris als "rassistischen Terroranschlag" ein. Nun teilen die Ermittler mit, welche Schriften sie in der Wohnung des Beschuldigten gefunden haben.

items.title: Russian drone attack on Kharkiv kills one person and injures others
items.teaser: One person was killed and three others were injured as a result of a Russian drone strike in the Novobavarskyi district of Kharkiv.

items.title: Russian attack leaves one district in Vinnytsia region without power
items.teaser: In one of the districts of the Vinnytsia region, a Russian strike on an energy facility led to an emergency power outage.

items.title: Nach rassistischem Terror-Anschlag - Macron-Patzer am Wut-Samstag empört Franzosen
items.teaser: In der angespannten Lage vor den Demos leistete sich der Präsident einen Patzer.

items.title: Wie Polen und die Ukraine die Deeskalation suchen
items.teaser: Das Verhältnis Polens zum Nachbarn Ukraine ist heikel. Nun flammt wieder Streit auf - es geht ums Gedenken an das Massaker von Wolhynien. Beide Staaten versuchen die Deeskalation.

items.title: Drone debris falls on parking lot in central Kyiv, injuring one person
items.teaser: In the Shevchenkivskyi District of the capital, debris from a drone damaged parked cars; one person was injured.

items.title: Musk says Ukrainian military violated Starlink terms of use, loophole has been closed
items.teaser: Elon Musk has claimed Ukraine's military used Starlink for offensive drone strikes in violation of its terms, adding that the loophole is now closed.

items.title: Ukraine: Starlink satellite speeds restored to normal
items.teaser: The announcement comes after Starlink and Starshield restrictions had disrupted military operations in Ukraine and sparked tensions with the US.

items.teaser: Nach mutmaßlichem Brandanschlag in Bulgarien wurde ein europäischer Haftbefehl erlassen.

items.teaser: Spektakuläre Rettungsaktion: Ukrainischer Soldat mit Drohne von der Front gerettet

items.title: Russian attack on Synelnykove kills three people and injures eight others
items.teaser: As a result of the shelling of Synelnykove in the Dnipropetrovsk region, three people were killed, at least eight were injured, and cars were damaged.

items.title: Russian attack sparks warehouse fire in Kharkiv suburb
items.teaser: In the Bezlyudivka community of Kharkiv region, a Russian military drone struck the roof of a warehouse belonging to a private company in the evening, causing a fire.

items.title: Luftstreitkräfte: Russland hat 2597 Drohnen binnen einer Woche gegen Ukraine gestartet – mehr als 87% davon wurden abgewehrt
items.teaser: In der vergangenen Woche haben die ukrainischen Luftstreitkräfte fast 2300 von 2597 russischen Kampfdrohnen abgewehrt. Die Abfangquote liegt bei über 87 %.

items.title: Russian airstrikes on Sloviansk injure two people and damage buildings
items.teaser: The Russians attacked Sloviansk in the Donetsk region with high-explosive bombs, damaging residential and administrative buildings, an infrastructure facility, and two educational institutions; at least two people were wounded.

items.title: "Fortgeschrittenes Stadium": Geheimdienst-Memo: Iran plant Anschläge auf US-Bürger
items.teaser: Ein internes Schreiben des US-Geheimdienstkoordinators warnt vor konkreten Vorbereitungen des Iran für Angriffe auf US-Personal. Diese könnten im Nahen Osten und weiteren Ländern erfolgen. Washington zieht bereits Personal aus Saudi-Arabien ab.

items.title: Exportkontrolle Aktuell – Sonder-Newsletter
Merz: Russia seeks to destabilise Germany on a daily basis

items.title: Drone debris found in Latvia
items.teaser: The Latvian National Armed Forces reported the discovery of debris from a drone that had crashed on the country’s territory.

items.title: Lviv-based business wins about US$1.6m from Russia over sunflower lost in Luhansk Oblast
items.teaser: The Commercial Court of Luhansk Oblast has ordered Russia to compensate a Ukrainian agricultural company after its stock was seized in occupied Svatove.

items.title: Militärgeheimdienst warnt vor Russlands Operationen unter falscher Flagge in Europa
items.teaser: Russland bereitet Operationen unter fremder Flagge zur Destabilisierung in Europa vor, um dann die Schuld dafür der Ukraine in die Schuhe zu schieben, heisst es in einer Pressemitteilung des ukrainischen Militärgeheimdienstes (HUR).

items.title: Russians attack Dnipropetrovsk Oblast: three killed, high-rise on fire, shop damaged
items.teaser: A Russian UAV has hit a city in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, starting a fire in a residential building, killing three people and injuring eight others, including a child.

items.title: Lubinets discusses details of Oleshky humanitarian mission with Russian ombudswoman
items.teaser: Dmytro Lubinets, the Ukrainian Parliament’s Commissioner for Human Rights, held an online meeting with Russian Human Rights Ombudswoman Yana Lantratova, during which they discussed the previously agreed-upon details of the humanitarian mission in Oleshky.

items.title: Ukrainian forces reportedly strike Russian targets 2,500 kilometers from border
items.teaser: Ukraine struck several targets, including a petrochemical plant and a warehouse in Siberia around 2,500 kilometers away from the border on Oct. 24, monitoring channels reported.

items.title: Ternopil region serviceman captured while seriously wounded returns home after four years in captivity
items.teaser: Andrii Chverenchuk, from the village of Skomorokhy in the Ternopil region, has returned home after four years in captivity. He was captured while suffering from a serious wound.

items.title: Industriegebiet im russischen Omsk von Drohnen angegriffen
items.teaser: In der russischen Stadt Omsk, die mehr als 2500 Kilometer von der ukrainischen Grenze entfernt liegt, ist ein Industriegebiet von Drohnen angegriffen worden.

items.title: Drones attack industrial hub in Russia's Omsk – social media
items.teaser: Drones have attacked an industrial hub in the Russian city of Omsk, located more than 2,500 km from Ukraine.

items.title: Wreckage of foreign drone found in Latvia, investigation underway
items.teaser: Debris from an unidentified unmanned aerial vehicle has been located in the Alūksne district, prompting military and police officials to initiate a joint probe.

items.title: Russian forces strike Chernihiv, fire breaks out, two injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Chernihiv on Saturday, sparking a fire in a disused building.

items.title: North Korea improves ballistic missiles and mass-produces drones with Russian support – NYT
items.teaser: Pyongyang is rapidly advancing its ballistic missile technology and mass-producing attack drones by leveraging its military alliance with Moscow.

items.title: Selenskyj: Starlink und Starshield funktionieren wieder bei notwendigen Geschwindigkeiten
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj hat die Aufhebung der Beschränkungen für das Starlink-Satelliteninternet in der Ukraine bestätigt.

items.title: President announces changes in regions and discusses preparations for winter
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said discussions had been held on governance issues in Kyiv, resilience plans and preparations for winter, and announced changes in some regions.

items.title: Russian drone hits food shop in Nikopol district: four injured, including child
items.teaser: A Russian drone attacked a food shop in the Nikopol district in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, severely injuring a 14-year-old boy and hurting three adult men.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine awaits air defense interceptors, preparing meetings with partners
items.teaser: Ukraine is continuing talks with the United States and European partners on resuming deliveries of interceptors to counter Russian ballistic missiles. It also expects diplomatic contacts to continue next week and humanitarian access to the town of Oleshky in the Kherson region to be unblocked.

items.title: Russische Drohnen attackieren Farm in Region Sumy, es gibt eine Tote und vier Verletzte
items.teaser: Am 24. Oktober hat das russische Militär ein Rinderzuchtunternehmen im Bezirk Konotop in der Region Sumy mit Drohnen angegriffen. Eine Person wurde getötet, vier weitere verletzt, teilte der Staatliche Rettungsdienst auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Russian drones attack farm in Sumy region, one killed, four injured
items.teaser: Russian drones attacked an agricultural enterprise in the Sumy region's Konotop district on the afternoon of October 24, killing one person and injuring four others.

items.title: Drones attack chemical plant in Russia's Omsk, 2,500 km from Ukraine – OSINT
items.teaser: Ukrainian drones have struck the Omsky Kauchuk chemical facility deep inside Russia, causing a massive fire 2,500 km from the border.

items.title: Neue Details zum Brandanschlag - Hitlers Teehaus wird wieder aufgebaut
items.teaser: Die Polizei hat einen Mann (33) gefasst. Zwei mögliche Motive werden geprüft.

items.title: One killed and two injured in Russian attack on business in Lozova, Kharkiv Oblast – photos
items.teaser: On Saturday 24 October, Russian forces struck a business in the city of Lozova, Kharkiv Oblast, killing one man and injuring two other civilians.

items.title: Wenn der Strom ausfällt: So übte der Katastrophenschutz in Harrislee
items.teaser: Das Szenario: Ein Anschlag legt die Stromversorgung großflächig lahm. 160 Einsatzkräfte aus dem ganzen Land waren dabei.

items.title: European Parliament Vice President ends hunger strike following Oleshky ceasefire announcement
items.teaser: European Parliament Vice President Pina Picierno announced the hunger strike on Oct. 20, demanding an immediate humanitarian truce in the occupied town.

items.title: Selenskyj verhängt Sanktionen gegen Hersteller russischer ballistischer Raketen sowie Zulieferer von Waffenkomponenten
items.teaser: Präsident der Ukraine, Wolodymyr Selenskyj, hat Sanktionen gegen Unternehmen und Einzelpersonen, die bei der Produktion russischer ballistischer Waffen helfen und die den russischen Rüstungsunternehmen Ausrüstung und Komponenten für Drohnen, militärische Luftfahrt, Panzertechnik und Raketen liefern, verhängt.

items.title: Starlink and Starshield back to required speeds – Zelensky
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Starlink and Starshield had resumed operating at the speeds available before the restrictions were introduced. This is important for frontline logistics and protecting Ukraine against jet-powered Shahed drones.

items.title: Bundesanwaltschaft: Kampfausbildung beim IS geplant? 21-Jähriger in U-Haft
Kiew bestätigt: Satelliteninternet Starlink läuft normal
items.teaser: Die Ukraine braucht Starlink für Kommunikation und Drohnensteuerung. Laut Kiew läuft der Dienst wieder normal. Wer die Einschränkungen veranlasst hat, ist weiterhin unklar.

items.title: Ukraine begins process of joining OECD Nuclear Energy Agency – Shmyhal
items.teaser: The Steering Committee of the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development's Nuclear Energy Agency (NEA) has supported the launch of the process for Ukraine to join the agency.

items.title: Ex-PM Yuliia Svyrydenko to represent Ukraine in joint US investment fund
items.teaser: The Ukrainian government has appointed former prime minister Yuliia Svyrydenko as its authorised representative to the US-Ukraine Reconstruction Investment Fund.

items.title: Zelenskyy on Oleshky: Situation is dire, we hope US mediation will work
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy hopes that American mediation will help unblock the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky, although the situation remains dire due to mined roads.

items.title: Four people injured in Russian drone attack in Nikopol district, including child
items.teaser: Four people, including a child, were injured in a Russian drone attack in the Pokrovske community, Nikopol district.

items.title: Blackout auf der Krim nach Drohnenangriff
items.teaser: Nach einem ukrainischen Drohnenangriff ist auf der von Russland annektierten Krim in der Nacht der Strom komplett ausgefallen. „Blackout auf der Krim. Die wichtigsten Umspannwerke sind außer Betrieb gesetzt worden. Die gesamte Halbinsel ist ohne Strom“, wie das OSINT- Projekt Exilenova + berichtet.

items.title: Germany in talks to buy Ukrainian jet-powered drones
items.teaser: The Bars jet powered drone has a range of 1,000 kilometers and can reach speeds of up to 700 kilometers per hour.

items.title: Zelenskyy confirms Starlink and Starshield are back up and running: Now we have the speed we need
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has confirmed the lifting of speed restrictions on Starlink and Starshield terminals in Ukraine, which has restored crucial frontline communications.

items.title: Ukrainian, Romanian PMs discuss defense, energy, logistics
items.teaser: Ukrainian Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi in a phone call with his Romanian counterpart Luca Niculescu proposed establishing cooperation through intergovernmental consultations and invited him to Ukraine.

items.title: Russian forces attack farm in Sumy Oblast: woman and animals killed, people injured – photo
items.teaser: A Russian drone attacked a cattle farm in Sumy Oblast on 24 October, leaving a 31-year-old woman who worked there dead, injuring four other people and killing several animals.

items.title: Aufklärung mit Escape-Spiel - Verfassungsschutz geht unter die Gamer
items.teaser: Der Verfassungsschutz bringt ein Escape-Spiel zu Cyber- und Spionageabwehr heraus.

items.title: Khmara discusses procurement and production development with defense industry representatives
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara discussed rules for manufacturers, predictability of state procurement, the development of production capacity and mechanisms for controlled exports with representatives of Ukraine's defense industry.

items.title: European Parliament Vice-President agrees to stop hunger strike over Oleshky
items.teaser: European Parliament Vice-President Pina Picierno has agreed to end her hunger strike after a ceasefire and humanitarian aid agreements for Oleshky were reached.

items.title: Im Umfeld des Tatverdächtigen: Weitere Festnahmen nach Schussangriff bei Paris
items.teaser: In Frankreich gehen die Ermittlungen nach dem Schussangriff in der Nähe von Paris weiter. Die Anti-Terrorstaatsanwaltschaft berichtet von drei weiteren Festnahmen aus dem Umfeld des Tatverdächtigen. Unklar ist weiter, ob es sich bei der Tat um einen rassistisch motivierten Anschlag handelt.

items.title: Russen greifen Losowa mit Raketen an: ein Mensch getötet, zwei weitere verletzt
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Raketenangriff auf die Stadt Losowa in der Region Charkiw ist ein Mann ums Leben gekommen. Zwei weitere Männer wurden verletzt, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Oleh Synehubow, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: UK PM urges Trump to ensure Ukraine has access to Starlink
items.teaser: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham held a phone call with U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday and emphasized the importance of ensuring Ukraine has full access to Starlink so it can continue defending itself against Russian aggression.

items.title: Motion for Preliminary Injunction and Summary Judgment Filed in Section 338 Lawsuit
items.teaser: Following up on the complaint filed earlier this week, yesterday the plaintiffs in the Section 338 lawsuit at the CIT filed a Motion for Preliminary Injunction and/or Summary Judgment for Permanent Injunction.

items.title: Ukraine sanctions Russian arms suppliers as Moscow ramps up attacks

items.title: Zelensky on his relationship with Trump: “I don't play games with him”
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that he is ready to sign a peace agreement with Russia today, if possible, while expressing regret over the reduction in U.S. aid.

items.title: The Atlantic: CIA director would not dissuade Trump if he decided to cut off intelligence to Ukraine
items.teaser: The US has yet to formally halt intelligence sharing with Ukraine, but CIA Director John Ratcliffe would not stand in President Donald Trump’s way if he decided to do so.

items.title: Region Charkiw: Sieben Menschen, darunter zwei Kinder, durch russischen Beschuss verletzt
items.teaser: Russische Truppen haben innerhalb eines Tages die Bezirkshauptstadt und weitere 15 Ortschaften in der Region Charkiw angegriffen.

items.title: Russian missile strike on Lozova kills one person and injures two others
items.teaser: In Lozova, Kharkiv region, one man was killed and two others were wounded as a result of a Russian missile strike.

items.teaser: Die Satellitenkommunikation von SpaceX in der Ukraine funktioniert nach Angaben aus Kiew wieder stabil. Die ukrainische Armee meldet derweil Angriffe auf russische Industrieanlagen.

items.title: Zelenskyy imposes sanctions on Russian missile manufacturers and military industry suppliers
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has imposed sanctions on Russian companies and individuals involved in producing missiles, drones, military aircraft and other weapons.

items.title: Angriff auf Trauerfeier - Zahl der Toten in Jordanien auf acht gestiegen
items.teaser: Die Zahl der Toten bei dem Anschlag auf eine christliche Gemeinde in Jordanien ist auf acht gestiegen.

items.title: UK PM asks Trump to ensure Ukraine has full access to Starlink
items.teaser: The office of UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said that he raised Ukraine's need for access to the Starlink satellite communications system during a conversation with US President Donald Trump.

items.title: Zelensky imposes sanctions on Russian ballistic weapons makers and defense industry component suppliers
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has imposed sanctions against entities and individuals who assist in the production of Russian ballistic weapons, as well as those who supply the Russian defense industry with equipment and components for drones, military aircraft, armored vehicles, and missile systems.

items.title: Russia secretly financed Alaska gas project

items.teaser: Seit Monaten ist Oleschky in der südukrainischen Region Cherson abgeriegelt. Eine lokale Feuerpause soll Hilfslieferungen und die Evakuierung der Zivilbevölkerung ermöglichen.

items.title: Stefanchuk discusses bilateral cooperation with Hungarian partners
items.teaser: During a visit to Budapest to commemorate the 70th anniversary of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution, Verkhovna Rada Chairman Ruslan Stefanchuk met with Hungarian National Assembly Speaker Ágnes Forszthoffer, Prime Minister Péter Magyar, and Hungarian President András Baka.

items.title: Rubio ruft Ukraine und Russland zu Kompromiss im Donbas auf
items.teaser: Der US-Außenminister Marco Rubio erklärte, dass sich der Krieg Russlands gegen die Ukraine auf den Donbas beziehe,

items.title: German ambassador: Friendship with Russia will not be restored – Putin threw it out of the window
items.teaser: German Ambassador to Ukraine Boris Ruge does not support the idea that ties with Russia should be restored or that Russian energy supplies to Europe via Ukraine should resume in order to achieve a lasting peace.

items.title: Kyiv's power ring under attack: why the capital faces a winter of blackouts
items.teaser: Hopes for a mild winter or inaccuracies in Russian strikes will not help Kyiv get through this winter without problems with its electricity supply. The only question is how long the power cuts will last and whether air defence forces and power engineers will manage to prevent the worst-case scenario.

items.title: Saved wounded soldiers since 2015: Journalist and veteran Olena Sharhovska dies
items.teaser: Olena "Jane" Sharhovska, a veteran of the Hospitallers medical battalion who worked as a translator and journalist in civilian life, has died. Olena had been saving wounded soldiers since 2015.

items.title: Russian forces attack critical and civilian infrastructure in Zhytomyr region
items.teaser: On the night of October 23–24, the Russian Federation’s armed forces attacked critical and civilian infrastructure facilities in the Zhytomyr region.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 4, injure 78 across Ukraine over past day, as drone strikes Kyiv residential building in the morning
items.teaser: Overnight, Russian forces launched 126 drones, 61 of which were jet-powered, while Ukraine's air defense managed to suppress 101 drones, including 50 jet-powered drones, the Air Force said.

items.title: Russen töten zwei Zivilisten in Region Donezk, 18 weitere verletzt
items.teaser: Die russischen Angreifer haben am 23. Oktober zwei Menschen in der Region Donezk getötet.

items.title: Defense Forces strike Tolyattikauchuk and Proton-Elektrotex plants, and aircraft at Yeysk airfield in Russia
items.teaser: On October 23 and during the night of October 24, the Ukrainian Defense Forces carried out strikes on key targets within Russia. It has been confirmed that the main production building of JSC “Proton-Elektrotex” in Orel, the “Tolyattikauchuk” plant in Tolyatti, and an aircraft at the Yeysk airfield were struck.

items.title: Khmara: Starlink and Starshield speeds above 400 km/h have resumed, says DM
items.teaser: The Ukrainian Ministry of Defense’s monitoring systems are recording that Starlink/Starshield has resumed speeds exceeding 400 km/h with a stable connection.

items.title: Zelenskyy: Ukraine received only 24 Patriot missiles from US over 3 months
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Ukraine received only 24 Patriot interceptor missiles from the US over the past three months, while it needs around 350 per month.

items.title: Verteidigungsministerium verzeichnet bei Starlink/Starshield eine Geschwindigkeit von 400 km/h
items.teaser: Die Überwachungssysteme des Verteidigungsministeriums der Ukraine registrieren die Wiederherstellung der Starlink/Starshield-Geschwindigkeit auf über 400 km/h bei stabiler Verbindung

items.title: Ukraine strikes factory in Russia's Tolyatti, airfield in Krasnodar Krai, General Staff says
items.teaser: Videos filmed by locals show smoke billowing over the city in the early morning, with reports claiming that the Tolyattikauchuk chemical plant was attacked and that evacuations took place at the AvtoVAZ car manufacturing factory.

items.title: Germany in talks with Ukraine to purchase Bars jet-powered drones – Bloomberg, photo
items.teaser: Germany plans to replenish its stockpile of precision-guided weapons with several thousand missiles from European arms manufacturers. In particular, the country is in talks with Ukraine regarding Bars jet-powered drones.

items.title: Fire extinguished in Kyiv’s Obolon district following Russian attack
items.teaser: Rescue workers extinguished a fire in Kyiv’s Obolon district that broke out on the morning of October 24 as a result of a Russian attack.

items.title: Energie-Entkoppelung: So abhängig ist Europa noch von Russland
items.teaser: Nach dem Vollangriff auf die Ukraine wollte Europa schnell unabhängig werden von russischer Energie. Teilweise ist das auch gelungen. Vor allem bei Öl und Uran bleiben aber alte Abhängigkeiten. Von Jean-Marie Magro.

items.title: Luftabwehr neutralisiert 101 von 126 russischen Drohnen
items.teaser: Die ukrainische Luftabwehr hat 101 Kampfdrohnen unschädlich gemacht, mit denen Russland seit Abend dem 23. Oktober das Gebiet der Ukraine angegriffen hat.

items.title: General Staff: Ukraine strikes Tolyattikauchuk plant, missile component manufacturer and aircraft in Yeysk
items.teaser: Ukrainian forces struck the Proton-Electrotex missile component plant, the Tolyattikauchuk facility and an aircraft at Russia’s Yeysk airfield on 23-24 October.

items.title: Alarm an Polens Ostgrenze: "Wir leben hier in solcher Angst"
items.teaser: Warnnachrichten praktisch täglich auf dem Handy: In Polens Grenzregion zur Ukraine rückt der Krieg gefühlt näher. Für die Bewohner bedeutet das ein Leben im Alarmmodus.

items.title: Geschwindigkeit bei Starlink und Starshield von über 27.000 km/h
items.teaser: Starlink und Starshield bewegen sich mit einer Geschwindigkeit von mehr als 27.000 km/h – Stand: Morgen den 24. Oktober.

items.title: The trouble with loving Russia: Evan Gershkovich's memoir seeks sentimentality in a lost country
items.teaser: By the end of his pre-trial detention at Moscow's infamous Lefortovo Prison, American journalist Evan Gershkovich had developed a curious rapport with the FSB investigator tasked with proving he was a spy. "Most people break after four months or so, but you're still holding strong

items.title: Marine from Mykolaiv region returns from Russian captivity after more than four years
items.teaser: Marine Yevhen Uimanov from the Mykolaiv region has returned from Russian captivity—one of three men from the same family who, from the very first days of the full-scale invasion, stood up to defend their country and had been held captive since April 2022.

items.title: Open Position: Assistant Editor of Kluwer Arbitration Blog
items.teaser: The Editorial Board of Kluwer Arbitration Blog announces the opening of the following position with Kluwer Arbitration Blog: Assistant Editor for Southeast Asia . items.title: Starshield operations restored to speeds of more than 400 km/h, Ukraine's Defense Ministry says
items.teaser: "We record a speed of more than 400 kilometers per hour, the connection is stable," the ministry said.

items.title: Ukraine's Sine Engineering launches joint defense tech initiative with Finland
items.teaser: The initiative will focus on resilient communications, navigation, and onboard autonomy, as Sine Engineering specializes in producing satellite-independent navigation software, enabling drones to fly without relying on GPS.

items.title: Drohnenangriff in Russland auf Toljatti-Werk, das Komponenten für Raketentreibstoff herstellt
items.teaser: Ukrainische Drohnen haben in der Nacht zum 24. Oktober das Werk „Toljattikautschuk“ in der Stadt Toljatti in der Region Samara der Russischen Föderation getroffen.

items.title: Nach tödlichem Angriff - Israelische Armee startet Großoffensive im Westjordanland
items.teaser: Nach dem tödlichen Angriff auf israelische Soldaten in der Stadt Hebron hat die Armee nach eigenen Angaben eine Anti-Terror-Operation im Westjordanland gestartet. Dazu gehört unter anderem die Abriegelung der Stadt Hebron.

items.title: One killed, 18 injured in Russian attacks in Chernihiv region over past day
items.teaser: A man was killed and 18 other people were injured in Russian strikes on an enterprise in the Chernihiv region on October 23.

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages 181 Gefechte an der Front: Der Feind setzt über 10.000 Drohnen ein
items.teaser: Am 23. Oktober kam es zu 181 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front, die Mehrheit davon Richtung Kostjantyniwka.

items.title: Starlink and Starshield operating at speeds above 161 km/h – source
items.teaser: As of the morning of October 24, the Starlink and Starshield satellite communication systems were operating at speeds above 161 km/h.

items.title: Russian strikes injure seven people in Kharkiv region, including two children
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked the regional center and 15 other settlements in the Kharkiv region over the past day, injuring seven people, including two children.

items.title: Ukraine-US-Russia talks could take place in Abu Dhabi or Switzerland – Sky News
items.teaser: The next round of talks between Ukraine, the US and Russia could take place in Abu Dhabi or Switzerland in a couple of weeks, according to US government sources.

items.title: Drones attack Russia's Tolyattikauchuk plant producing components for rocket fuel – media
items.teaser: A fire broke out at the Tolyattikauchuk plant in Russia's Samara region overnight into Saturday, October 24, following a drone attack. The plant produces, among other things, synthetic rubber used in solid rocket fuel.

items.title: Starlink is working again at speeds above 161 km/h – UP sources
items.teaser: Ukraine's defence forces and Defence Ministry specialists have recorded Starlink and Starshield operating at speeds above 161 km/h, as checks continue to establish the upper limit and assess how fully communications have been restored.

items.title: Verluste russischer Armee in Ukraine liegen binnen eines Tages bei 1980 weiteren Angreifern und zwei Luftabwehrsystemen
items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 24. Oktober 2024 bei rund 1.576.600 Soldaten. Binnen eines Tages wurden weitere 1980 Besatzer getötet.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,576,600 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 1,980 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: How Ukrainians in US advocate for Ukraine’s interests
items.teaser: For decades, the Ukrainian community in the U.S. has been working to ensure that relations between Ukraine and the U.S. remain strong and that Ukraine has reliable partners in Washington.

items.title: War update: 181 clashes on front lines over past day, heaviest fighting on Kostiantynivka axis
items.teaser: A total of 181 combat engagements between Ukraine's Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded on the front line on October 23, with the heaviest fighting on the Kostiantynivka axis.

items.title: Russian attacks on three Ukrainian oblasts kill two people and injure 27
items.teaser: Russian attacks across three Ukrainian oblasts on 23 October killed two people and injured 27 others. Civilian casualties were reported in Kramatorsk, Sloviansk, Kherson Oblast and Kharkiv Oblast.

items.title: Partisans destroy communications tower in Russia's Belgorod region
items.teaser: Agents of the ATESH partisan movement destroyed a communications tower near the settlement of Shebekino in Russia's Belgorod region, disrupting the operation of a repeater that Russian troops used to maintain a stable signal and guide and control drones.

items.title: Drohnenangriff auf Kyjiw: Zwei Verletzte, Wohnhaus beschädigt
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Drohnenangriff am Morgen auf Kyjiw wurden zwei Menschen verletzt.

items.title: Russian forces attack Ukraine with 126 drones, strikes recorded at 14 locations
items.teaser: Russia launched 126 drones against Ukraine overnight, including 61 jet-powered Shaheds. Ukraine's air defences recorded strikes at 14 locations, while debris from downed drones fell at five others.

items.title: Russian army loses 1,980 troops, two air defense systems in Ukraine war over past day
items.teaser: The total combat losses of Russian troops since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, from February 24, 2022, to October 24, 2026, have reached approximately 1,576,600 personnel, including 1,980 killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Trump floats possibility of imposing 200% tariffs on Ukraine and Russia to force peace
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump has said the United States could impose 200% tariffs on Ukraine and Russia to force them to end the war.

items.title: Fire breaks out at Russian chemical plant in Tolyatti after drone attack – photos, videos
items.teaser: Russian Telegram channels have reported a fire at the Tolyattikauchuk synthetic rubber plant in Tolyatti following a drone attack. There have also been reports of a possible evacuation at AvtoVAZ.

items.title: Mass blackouts reported across occupied Crimea
items.teaser: According to satellite imagery from NASA FIRMS, the Taman substation in Russia's Krasnodar Krai — a key energy node supplying electricity to Crimea —was damaged in an overnight attack.

items.title: Russian drone attack damages house in Kyiv, injures two
items.teaser: A private residential house was damaged during a Russian drone attack on Kyiv this morning, injuring two people.

items.title: Large-scale blackout hits Crimea after drone attack
items.teaser: A large-scale blackout affected the entire temporarily occupied Crimean peninsula overnight on October 24. The occupation authorities reported damage to energy infrastructure across the peninsula.

items.title: Rubio reveals theory on Russia's war against Ukraine ahead of next US peace push
items.teaser: "People keep talking about it's a war in Ukraine. ... It's about one region of the country," U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said.

items.title: Russia loses 1,980 soldiers over past day
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff has updated data on Russian losses: Russia lost 1,980 soldiers killed and wounded over the past day.

items.title: One killed, six injured in Russian airstrike on Kramatorsk
items.teaser: Russian forces dropped three FAB-250 aerial bombs on Kramatorsk on the afternoon of October 23, killing one person and injuring six others, including three children.

items.title: US lawmakers urge Pentagon to expand Starshield contract for Ukraine
items.teaser: A bipartisan, bicameral group of US lawmakers has called on Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to expand the Pentagon's Starshield contract and ensure uninterrupted access to Starlink and Starshield for Ukrainian forces following recent disruptions.

items.title: Russian attack on Kyiv injures two people and damages house
items.teaser: Two people were injured after a Russian drone attack damaged a house in Kyiv in the morning.

items.title: Russia launched 2,597 drones at Ukraine over past week, air defenses neutralized over 87%
items.teaser: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized nearly 2,300 Russian attack drones over the past week, achieving an interception rate of more than 87%.

items.title: Zelensky 'maybe not such a big humanitarian as Putin,' he quips as Ukraine's relations with Trump unravel
items.teaser: The president made the comment in an interview with ABC News two days after U.S. Envoy Steve Witkoff praised Vladimir Putin as "a humanitarian." Hours later, Russia struck Kyiv with ballistic missiles and cluster munitions.

items.title: Israel startet "Anti-Terror-Operation" im Westjordanland
items.teaser: Am Abend beginnt Israels Armee eigenen Angaben zufolge einen Einsatz gegen Terroristen im Westjordanland.

items.title: US senators threaten to block Trump's appointments over Starlink restrictions in Ukraine – NYT
items.teaser: Republican and Democratic senators have warned the White House they will hold up confirmation votes until Trump's administration restores critical satellite communications used by Ukrainian troops, amid growing tensions over US policy towards Russia.

items.title: Ukraine repatriates seven more civilians in exchange with Russia
items.teaser: Ukraine has managed to bring home seven more civilians as part of a prisoner exchange with Russia.

items.title: Zelenskyy: We are ready to end this war as quickly as possible
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says Kyiv is prepared to reach a peace deal to end the war as soon as possible, but will not recognise Russian-occupied Ukrainian territory as Russian.

items.title: Nach Anschlag auf Soldaten: Israel startet Operation im Westjordanland
items.teaser: Nach den tödlichen Schüssen auf zwei Soldaten hat Israels Armee einen "Anti-Terror-Einsatz" im Westjordanland begonnen. Man suche dort nach Waffen und Terrorinfrastruktur. Israels Premier drohte zudem mit einem großagelegten Militäreinsatz.

items.title: Drug parcels: Teen girl suspected of poisoning Ukrainian servicemen detained in Zhytomyr region
items.teaser: Police in the Zhytomyr region have detained a 17-year-old girl who, according to investigators, helped Russia's Federal Security Service (FSB) poison Ukrainian servicemen.

items.title: Rassistischer Terroranschlag?: Nach Schüssen bei Paris - Ermittler finden Sprengfalle
items.teaser: Nach dem Schussangriff bei Paris spricht Frankreichs Präsident Macron von einem "Wendepunkt" und vermutet einen "rassistischen Terroranschlag". Die Ermittler stoßen in der Wohnung des Verdächtigen auf eine Sprengfalle. Im Auto finden sie ein Maschinengewehr.

items.title: Nahost - Israel startet "Anti-Terror-Operation" im Westjordanland nach tödlichem Schusswaffenangriff in Hebron
items.teaser: Nach dem tödlichen Angriff auf israelische Soldaten in der Stadt Hebron hat die Armee nach eigenen Angaben eine Anti-Terror-Operation im Westjordanland gestartet.

items.title: US lawmakers demand answers from Elon Musk over Ukraine Starlink restrictions
items.teaser: In a public letter, Democratic Senators and Representatives listed five questions concerning Starlink restrictions impacting Ukrainian forces, addressed to Musk. The demand comes as Ukrainian forces continue to experience severe problems operating Starlink military systems.

items.title: Trypillia settlement discovered above Verteba Cave in Ternopil region
items.teaser: Scientists have discovered a Trypillia settlement on the surface above Verteba Cave in the Ternopil region during extensive magnetometric surveys using unmanned aerial vehicles at two Trypillia culture sites included on UNESCO's Tentative List of World Heritage Sites.

items.title: This is the fancy new F-16 Ukraine could get. It’s not what its pilots need most.
items.teaser: Ukraine could buy newly built F-16 Block 70/72s from U.S. firm Lockheed Martin. But that's not the greatest need.

items.title: Ukraine now fights two enemies. One is America
items.teaser: In two weeks, Washington sanctioned the court prosecuting Putin, waived its own sanctions on Russia, and called him a humanitarian.

items.title: Widespread power cuts reported in Russian-occupied Crimea
items.teaser: Russian-installed officials have reported widespread power outages across occupied Crimea following an attack on energy infrastructure outside Sevastopol. Residents have reported disruptions in several major cities on the peninsula.

items.title: Kharkiv resident sentenced to 15 years in prison for setting fire to Ukrzaliznytsia relay cabinets
items.teaser: A court has found a Kharkiv resident guilty of setting fire to Ukrzaliznytsia (Ukrainian Railways) facilities on orders from enemy intelligence services and sentenced him to 15 years in prison.

items.title: That is about Donbas: Rubio on Russia's war against Ukraine
items.teaser: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio says the war centres on Russia's attempts to seize Donbas, while Ukraine refuses to give up the territory over concerns about its sovereignty and long-term security.

items.title: Russian airstrikes on Kramatorsk kill one person and injure six, including three children – photo
items.teaser: Russian forces dropped three FAB-250 aerial bombs on a residential area of Kramatorsk in Donetsk Oblast on 23 October, killing one person, injuring six civilians and damaging 27 houses.

items.title: Israel startet im Westjordanland "Anti-Terror-Operation"
items.teaser: Am Abend startet Israels Armee eigenen Angaben zufolge eine "Anti-Terror-Operation" im Westjordanland.

items.title: Kremlin-seized German company Metro AG transfers 1 billion rubles to Russian military without approval
items.teaser: Metro AG responded, saying it did not approve the donations. On Sept. 28, Russian President Vladimir Putin signed a decree placing the Russian subsidiary of Metro AG under the Kremlin's control.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1703: White House announces ceasefire for occupied Oleshky, where residents face starvation and blocked escape routes
items.teaser: Ukraine freed 270 captives, including American teacher Stephen Hubbard, as a drone sank a cargo ship off Romania and killed a Ukrainian sailor and Ukrainian Storm Shadows reportedly hit an Oryol plant that makes Iskander components.

items.title: Putin claims Russia is ready for new talks with Ukraine, calls occupied land historical Russia
items.teaser: He also cited unnamed genetic studies to claim Russians and Ukrainians are one people, a day after hosting a US envoy.

items.title: Poltava region receives over 130 generators from Germany
items.teaser: The Poltava region has received generators from Germany to support critical infrastructure.

items.title: Russian plant supplying components for Iskander missiles reportedly struck by Ukrainian Storm Shadow missiles
items.teaser: OSINT projects reported that a strike hit the Proton plant in Orel, a facility whose electronic components are used in several Russian weapons systems.

items.title: Trump considers 200% tariffs on Ukraine and Russia
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump has suggested imposing 200% tariffs on Ukraine and Russia, saying similar threats helped end five wars, but acknowledged that limited imports from the two countries could make the approach ineffective.

items.title: General Staff: Ukraine to implement ceasefire in Oleshky area starting October 27
items.teaser: Starting at midnight on October 27, Ukraine is implementing a ceasefire in a designated area to conduct a humanitarian operation in the temporarily occupied town of Oleshky.

items.title: 40,000 tons of Russian diesel are bound for New York—due four days after Americans vote
items.teaser: The tanker loaded at a Baltic port Ukrainian drones struck in March. Trump wants cheaper diesel before the midterms.

items.title: A modem from a Russian drone led reporters to its Chinese maker—which invoiced 500 for Russia’s drone plant
items.teaser: Posing as a Russian military supplier, journalists got a $2.87 million invoice, three bank accounts, and no pushback on military use.

items.title: Zelensky: Russia waging hybrid war against Europe to undermine aid to Ukraine
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Russia is waging a hybrid war against European countries, attacking them with drones in order to weaken support for Ukraine.

items.title: Melania Trump soll lokale Waffenruhe für ukrainische Stadt Oleschky ausgehandelt haben
items.teaser: Melania Trump soll lokale Waffenruhe für ukrainische Stadt Oleschky ausgehandelt haben

items.title: Frankreich rüstet sich für nächsten Protesttag
items.teaser: Frankreich fürchtet eine weitere Eskalation der aufgeheizten Stimmung. Diesmal will der Staat besser vorbereitet sein. Inmitten dieser Lage erschüttert ein mutmaßlich rassistisch motivierter Anschlag das Land. Von Cai Rienäcker.

items.title: Zelensky: Rubio to revisit Starlink restrictions in Ukraine within 48 to 72 hours
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Ukraine is testing Starlink’s performance in various areas, particularly near the front lines, and is counting on a decision by the U.S. administration and SpaceX to lift the speed restrictions.

items.title: Drone strike sinks cargo ship near Romania, killing Ukrainian sailor. Romanian President blames Russia
items.teaser: The Khoryv capsized about 13 nautical miles off Romania’s coast, with nine crew members rescued and three still missing. The incident adds to a wave of attacks threatening Black Sea shipping and Ukraine’s export routes.

items.title: Trilateral peace talks with Russia, US negotiators to begin in November, Zelensky says
items.teaser: The peace discussions will begin at the technical level with negotiation teams, Zelensky said. If those efforts prove productive, then meetings between Zelensky, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and U.S. President Donald Trump will be held.

items.title: Zelensky: Ukraine seeks strong ties with U.S. and partners, free of misunderstandings
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Ukraine seeks an open dialogue with the U.S. and other partners so that the world can better understand the situation in Ukraine and political leaders can make decisions that will bring peace closer.

items.title: Ukraine and Russia will introduce ceasefire near Oleshky from 27 October
items.teaser: Ukraine and Russia have announced a local ceasefire to allow a humanitarian operation in Russian-occupied Oleshky in Kherson Oblast, where residents are facing a humanitarian crisis.

items.title: How EU ships are still able to carry Trump's Russian diesel despite so many sanctions
items.teaser: A ship called the Agioi Fanendes, which had just left Russia's Baltic Sea port of Primorsk, was carrying 40,000 metric tons to New York and had been traveling westwards through the Baltic Sea ever since.

items.title: "Terror kennt keine Religion": Tote bei Anschlag auf griechisch-orthodoxe Kirche in Jordanien
items.teaser: Im Süden Jordaniens eröffnen Bewaffnete das Feuer auf einen Trauerzug. Die Angreifer sollen minutenlang geschossen haben. Die Führungsriege des Landes droht mit harten Konsequenzen.

items.title: Russia’s attacks on Black Sea shipping raise risk of global famine, German FM warns
items.teaser: As Russian strikes increasingly threaten civilian vessels and Ukrainian grain exports, Germany’s foreign minister warned that shipping disruptions could leave vulnerable countries without essential food and fertilizers.

items.title: Russia's attacks on Ukraine's capital, Kyiv, are intensifying. DW asked people on the ground what life is like
items.teaser: Russia's attacks on the Ukrainian capital are hitting harder and more frequently, making 2026 one of the long war's bloodiest years for Kyiv. DW asked people on the ground what life is like.

items.teaser: Speed limits for Starlink and Starshield are still in effect.

items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that Ukraine, the United States, and Russia have agreed to hold a trilateral meeting at the level of negotiating teams in the first half of November.

items.teaser: Austrian security authorities raised suspicions of espionage involving four Russian diplomats, prompting Vienna to declare them persona non grata.

items.title: Ukrainian forces to implement decisions on humanitarian mission in Oleshky – General Staff
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces will ensure the implementation of the Supreme Commander-in-Chief's decisions on carrying out a humanitarian mission in the temporarily occupied town of Oleshky in the Kherson region.

items.teaser: Ukraines Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj hat US-Präsident Donald Trump vorgeworfen, die Ukraine zu verraten. Der CDU-Außenpolitiker Armin Laschet hält das für keine gute Idee.
